command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin --prune; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git reset --hard origin/work/plug-screen-automation-entry-20260917; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c0fa5496a9ec64aa2b4bfb5634f8d42061096d84"; pnpm exec prettier --check docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md docs/architecture/refactor-boundaries.md docs/product/next-functional-steps.md docs/ux-polish-backlog.md; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; test -d "$SDK"; printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties; bash scripts/android/ensure-alpha-signing.sh; (cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug); APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; PROPERTIES="$HOME/.local-climate-link/android/alpha-signing.properties"; test -f "$PROPERTIES"; read_property(){ sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$PROPERTIES" | head -1; }; STORE_FILE="$(read_property storeFile)"; STORE_PASSWORD="$(read_property storePassword)"; KEY_ALIAS="$(read_property keyAlias)"; APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name apksigner | sort | tail -1)"; test -f "$STORE_FILE"; test -x "$APKSIGNER"; KEY_FP="$(keytool -list -v -keystore "$STORE_FILE" -storepass "$STORE_PASSWORD" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" 2>/dev/null | awk '/SHA256:/{print $2; exit}' | tr -d ':' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; APK_FP="$("$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" | sed -n 's/^Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"; test -n "$KEY_FP"; test "$KEY_FP" = "$APK_FP"; echo "ANDROID_APK=$APK"; echo "ANDROID_SIGNER_SHA256=$APK_FP"; shasum -a 256 "$APK"; ls -lh "$APK"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git rev-parse HEAD
